requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:76-84 builds '<@'.$mentionId.'>' and appends it as its own line, reserving room so the total stays <= 1800; :87-106 returns null for null/empty/non-string and only accepts /^[0-9]{17,20}$/ after trim (so '@everyone', 'abc', '123', '123\n@everyone', '123> \n@everyone' are rejected); the no-mention path still returns mb_substr($base, 0, 1800) unchanged; config/services.php:40 adds services.discord.mention_id from DISCORD_MENTION_ID, .env.example:11 adds DISCORD_MENTION_ID=, and docs/ops/devops.md:85,93 plus docs/ops/logging.md:105 document it. Contract signature of send() is untouched.

conventions.evidence: Docs were kept in sync in all three required places (.env.example:11, docs/ops/devops.md:85,93, docs/ops/logging.md:105) and the change reuses the existing formatContent() path instead of adding a service layer. However it violates the mandatory TDD rule ('No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test', conventions.md:15-18) because no test file appears anywhere in change.diff, and CHANGELOG.md is not updated under [Unreleased] (conventions.md:103).

security.evidence: Mention injection is closed off: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:99-105 trims and then requires /^[0-9]{17,20}$/ (ASCII digits only, no /u, anchored), so '@everyone'/'@here', extra characters, and embedded newlines are silently dropped; the mention is concatenated only from the validated id at :76-77, never from raw title/message/context. The webhook-URL redaction/no-op/soft-fail paths are untouched, so no secret is exposed.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains only .env.example, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php and the two ops docs; there is no tests/ file, so none of the new behavior (valid id, null/empty, '@everyone', short/embedded-newline ids, truncation keeping the mention, unchanged 1800-char behavior) is covered.

simplicity.evidence: The core is minimal and reuses the existing lines/implode pipeline (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:69,83) rather than duplicating formatting. The only waste is the unreachable guard at :80-82: the longest possible suffix is 23 characters, so `self::MaxContentLength - mb_strlen($suffix)` can never be negative given MaxContentLength = 1800.

readability.evidence: Small, focused private helper mentionId() (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:87-106) with an early-return shape that mirrors the surrounding style; names ($base, $mention, $suffix, $available) make the truncation logic self-explanatory and there is no debug output or dead code beyond the noted guard.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: the env var, the config key, the two code additions in the existing class, and the three documentation updates named in requirement 6. No unrelated refactor or new feature (no allowed_mentions tuning, no role/multi-user support) was added.

issues.explanation: The change ships with zero Pest/PHPUnit tests for the new mention behavior, which violates the project's non-negotiable TDD rule and leaves the id-validation and truncation edge cases unverified.
The 'keep docs in sync' convention requires an entry under [Unreleased] for the new DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting, and it was not added.

Inserting DISCORD_MENTION_ID replaced the blank line that separated the Discord block from the Hostinger block, so the new var now abuts the Hostinger comment; restoring the blank line keeps the file's grouping readable.
The `if ($available < 0) { $available = 0; }` guard is unreachable (the suffix is at most 23 chars) and can be dropped.

review.summary: The change correctly adds DISCORD_MENTION_ID / services.discord.mention_id, validates it as a 17-20 digit snowflake, appends the mention on its own line while reserving space inside the 1800-character cap, and documents the setting in all three required places. Functionally it meets every requirement with sound injection safety, but it ships no tests at all (a blocker under the project's TDD rule) and skips the CHANGELOG, so it needs changes before merging.
